name: Tower Bridge
prompt:
Create a precise isometric-style Tower Bridge scene over the Thames: two matching stone Gothic towers capped by blue-gray pointed roofs, two high-level walkways joining the towers, a lower road deck with the two bascule leaves closed, blue suspension elements extending toward both shores. Include tower arches, warm stone masonry hints and calm water. Use an orthographic camera and clean detailed miniature style.

Return only one complete standalone SVG document without Markdown fences. Use xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", width="1200", height="800", viewBox="0 0 1200 800". Build the entire artwork with native SVG paths, shapes, gradients, masks and filters. No scripts or embedded HTML. Use only native 2D drawing primitives. No WebGL, Three.js, 3D engine, external assets, images, fonts, imports or network calls. Depict the requested perspective using 2D shapes, paths and gradients. Create polished lighting, shadows and material variation with gradients and layered shapes. Frame the complete monument with its top and base visible and at least 10% margin. Do not obstruct it with foreground objects. No text overlays. Deterministic artwork, 1200x800 composition. Prioritize the visual result and working code. Use no more than 32000 output tokens including reasoning.
